description: Place the order — charges the user's real payment method. HARD GATE: the terminal asks the user to type 'yes'; a decline returns declined_by_user. Call ONLY after: (1) preview shown, (2) tip explicitly confirmed (delivery; pickup = 0 without asking), (3) payment method named to the user, (4) the user clearly said to place it. NOT idempotent — never retry without checking get_order_status first. Report success only when final_status.status == 'successful'.

confirmation_summary.description: Short human-readable summary shown at the terminal gate: store, items, total, tip, card (brand+last4), ETA

fulfillment.description: Only to match a mode explicitly set at preview

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

no_apply_credits.description: MUST match the preview: pass iff the user opted out of credits there

priority.description: MUST match the preview: pass iff the previewed quote used priority

scheduled_time.description: Must match the value used in preview, if any

team_account_id.description: Work benefits: budget's team_account_id when present

tip_cents.description: Dasher tip in CENTS (500 = $5.00). 0 only on explicit decline or pickup.

name: submit_order
